## Summary

- Huifang Liu and Daijiang Xie presented the deep research feature front-to-back, enabling a full flow from question input to report generation. [7]

## Evidence and analysis

### Recorded goal states

| Goal ID | Goal name | Recorded status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AG-M10 | Evidence Store and Citation Checker | Not started [2] |
| AG-M11 | Report Writer and Claim–Evidence Mapping | not recorded [2] |
| AG-M5 | Research Contract, Brief, Planner and Plan Validator | Not started [2] |
| AG-M6 | Local Research Tools and Trusted Evidence Chain | Finished [2] |
| AG-M7 | Research Data Persistence and Quality Validation | Finished [2] |
| AG-M8 | Research Graph Execution and Recovery | Finished [2] |
| AG-M9 | Trusted Report Generation and Query | Finished [2] |

### Unresolved issues

- The workflow is still hard-coded. [7]
- Huifang Liu will fix broken evidence links with Dai Jiaxing and split the fixed workflow into reusable tools for a smarter agent mode. [9]

### Next evaluation priorities

- Vincent emphasized prioritizing Q&A effectiveness over complex permission controls and proposed building a more challenging question set from existing conference data. [3]
- All team members：Consider buiding a mutil-dimension test case library (5–10 diverse questions) for continuous testing and iteration. [11]

## Limitations and uncertainty

Meeting demonstrations and goal statuses are separate evidence. A finished goal is not proof that its implementation was demonstrated. Action items remain pending; blank goal statuses remain not recorded. These historical snapshots do not establish later delivery.
